title: Terrain pre-processing for the upper Wadi Hanifa catchment at Al-Uyaynah, north-west of Riyadh
data: NASADEM_HGT version 001 by NASA JPL (2020): 1 arc-second (about 30 m) elevations from the SRTM flight of 11 to 21 February 2000, reprocessed by NASA, in whole metres above the EGM96 geoid, tiles n24e045, n24e046, n25e045 and n25e046.
method: Read a 46 × 40 km window (EPSG:32638, x 598000 to 644000, y 2731000 to 2771000) and reprojected it to 30 m cells by bilinear resampling.
Conditioned the DEM: filled single-cell pits, then filled depressions, then resolved flats.
Derived D8 flow direction and flow accumulation.

Chose an outlet on Wadi Hanifa at 46.4033° E, 24.9014° N, snapped it to the nearest cell draining at least 100 km², delineated the catchment above it and checked that it does not touch the window edge.
limits: This is terrain pre-processing that supports a hydrology study prepared and signed by a qualified office. It is not a hydrology study or a flood study: there is no rainfall, discharge or water depth. The NASADEM user guide (NASA JPL, 2020) gives the SRTM requirement as 16 m absolute vertical error at 90% and a global average absolute height error of about 6.8 m; heights are stored in whole metres.
